final_identity: pico_final (selector 39): W-only search + representation-aware affine compute

decisions.width: not searched; every parallel stage fixed at width 1
decisions.objective: DpObjectiveCost (serial compute/W + byte service) plus per-transition boundary cost
decisions.cache: Cedar cache placement, joint where applicable
decisions.profile: offline; not amortised into throughput; planning time reported separately

wikitext103.records: campaign default (input/output units reported per cell)

stop_rules: smoke gate must pass before the long campaign starts
failed cells are recorded and never reused as successes
no model parameter is fitted on a target plan; profiling is offline and frozen by hash
throughput differences inside the run-to-run range are reported as indistinguishable
no plan, workload or operator is dropped because a model does poorly on it
known_gaps: joint oracle (order x fusion x backend x W) blocked by the plan-replay entry point
no training-quality comparison (per the final decision)

relaxations.llava_note: Cedar's staged optimizer times out on LLaVA-Pretrain; only pico_final, plumber and raydata run there
